test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Doctors saved many lives during the pandemic.

options.text: Many lives have been saved by doctors during the pandemic.
Many lives were saved by doctors during the pandemic.
Many lives were being saved by doctors during the pandemic.
Many lives are saved by doctors during the pandemic.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Doctors saved many lives during the pandemic."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "many lives" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "saved" to "were saved" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "doctors."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "during the pandemic" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Many lives were saved by doctors during the pandemic."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Many lives have been saved by doctors during the pandemic." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Many lives were being saved by doctors during the pandemic." – Incorrect use of past continuous passive.
 
• **Option 4: **"Many lives are saved by doctors during the pandemic." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
